display_long_description:
# Welcome to the least efficient postal service in the world.

Put on your headset, grab your hands, and get ready to become **Berald** — the world's most determined (and least coordinated) mountain-climbing mail carrier. In this chaotic, physics-based VR adventure, you'll scale massive peaks using only your strength, stamina, and stubbornness to deliver the mail where drones fear to fly. 

Climbing isn't just a way to move — it's the whole game. Push off with your hands, cling to rocky surfaces, and fling yourself ever upward as you fight gravity, exhaustion, and your own flailing limbs. It's part workout, part comedy show, all multiplayer madness.

Whether you're climbing solo or in a lobby with up to **4 players**, you'll quickly learn that what starts as a heroic delivery mission often turns into a flailing, flopping, laugh-out-loud mess. 

- 🧗‍ **Fully Physical VR Climbing** – Built for hand-based locomotion. Push off, pull up, and parkour your way to victory.
- 📦 **Deliver That Mail** – Reach checkpoints and make your deliveries like a (somewhat) professional.
- 🎮 **4-Player Online Multiplayer** – Join up with friends or strangers for cooperative chaos or casual competition.
- 💪 **Stamina System** – Pace your climbs and rest when needed… or risk flinging yourself off the cliff in spectacular style.
- 🎩 **Customize Your Berald** – Unlock hats, outfits, and more to make your delivery look **fashionable.**
# Remember, mail waits for no one!
